dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d3 1 open api design and implementation for the 6g sandbox library

description: The implemented 6G-SANDBOX framework exposes network and experiment capabilities through open APIs and deploys modular library components into configurable trial networks containing virtual or physical elements. Related native reports describe OpenSAND non-terrestrial-network emulation, OpenRAN, P4/TSN and experiment automation. Deployed campaign management, KPI repositories and experiment-lifecycle tools support measurement handling; they are recorded as named components of this facility, without inventing independent code identities. The framework spans Athens, Berlin, Malaga and Oulu. Reports establish actual capabilities, while executable access, component licences and precise configurations remain unknown from metadata alone. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. The deposited documents or data declare CC BY 4.0 and public access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain bounded to explicitly named tests or locations, with other fields unknown. Only metadata was inspected, without reading measurements, archives, source code or document bodies. Related project reports may overlap; independent sample counts and equivalent test conditions are not assumed. This supports the source-defined communication system performance simulation role. Public paper access and licence do not establish executable availability, software rights or operating costs.
